profile.headline: Programmer
profile.summary:
Expert technologists with 20 years of experience working in and leading software development from start-ups to large Enterprises.

Knowledge and experience in the full lifecycle of application development and delivery. Including development, team building and leading, solution architecture, continuous delivery, agile project development and IT governance. Excellent team player and mentor with experience of instituting and using Scrum and other agile practices and methodologies.

Lifelong programmer with a deep interest in programming languages and techniques.

positions.title: CTO (Co-founder)
positions.description: Responsible for overall delivery of the Miso product to meet business requirements and putting in place the right people and infrastructure to do that. Oversee the selection and operation of all technologies and systems used in day-to-day operations of the company. Develop governance to ensure efficiency and security of all IT systems. Coordinate at board level to align all activities with business goals and requirements.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: As tech. lead my responsibilities were to build and lead the application development team. Define technologies and architecture for the solution. Set standards for programming tools and techniques. Develop a quality plan for the product. Facilitate the Scrum agile project management as the ‘Scrum Master’. Coach the business on Scrum methodology.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description: Designed and implemented enterprise services for a large multimillion-pound business transformation project. Defined code quality standards and metrics. Conducted code audits and reviews.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Worked as part of a high-performing Scrum development team on a large-scale public-sector project.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Worked as a Software Engineer on a variety of projects in complex IT environment. Gained experience of the full software development lifecycle under RUP. Worked with external teams to agree interfaces and coordinate delivery. Participated in internal development community groups to advise the business in making decisions regarding development and infrastructure tool sets.

positions.title: Systems Developer
positions.description:
Designed and developed a prototype hosted CMS for academic institutions. 

Work involved a large amount of customer contact to determine requirements and collaborate with a large number of external institutions and organisations.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Developer (intern) on Sun Microsystems Advanced Development team. Researched technologies that could benefit Sun's Services Engineering arm. Carried out code quality audit on a large-scale project using automated static analysis tools. Developed a reputation as a technical go-to within the Services Engineering organisation.
